title: Few-Shot Adaptation for Anomalous Sound Detection at Low False-Positive Rate
abstract: arXiv:2610.19893v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable fault detection is crucial for industrial machinery in large-scale facilities, where unexpected failures can cause costly downtime and production interruptions. Although acoustic monitoring provides a scalable solution for machine condition monitoring, its deployment is often constrained by high false-positive rates. We propose a two-step approach to automatic anomalous sound detection: first, when only normal operating audio samples are available, a regularized unsupervised model is deployed; then, after the first machine fault, a few-shot adaptation strategy exploits the anomalous samples acquired during the fault to improve the system. This adaptation increases the area under the precision-recall curve (AUPR) from 23.0 to 64.0 and improves detection in the low false-positive-rate region, with the partial area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (pAUROC) increasing from 39.6 to 72.8. translated_title: 低误报率下异常声音检测的小样本适应
translated_abstract: 可靠的故障检测对于大型设施中的工业机械至关重要，因为意外故障可能导致昂贵的停机时间和生产中断。尽管声学监测为机器状态监测提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，但其部署往往受到高误报率的限制。我们提出了一种自动异常声音检测的两步方法：首先，当仅有正常运行的音频样本可用时，部署一个正则化的无监督模型；然后，在第一次机器故障发生后，采用小样本适应策略利用故障期间获得的异常样本来改进系统。这种适应使精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPR）从23.0提升至64.0，并改善了低误报率区域的检测性能，部分受试者工作特征曲线下面积从39.6提升至72.8。我们还表明，协方差……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种两阶段异常声音检测方法，在仅有正常样本时部署正则化无监督模型，并在首次故障发生后利用小样本适应策略学习异常样本，将AUPR从23.0提升至64.0、pAUROC从39.6提升至72.8，显著改善了低误报率下的检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step anomalous sound detection approach that deploys a regularized unsupervised model when only normal samples are available, then applies few-shot adaptation exploiting anomalous samples after the first machine fault, raising AUPR from 23.0 to 64.0 and pAUROC from 39.6 to 72.8, thus substantially improving detection at low false-positive rates.
